name: [CONFIG] CT directions
decode: 0x1 = reverse CT1 polarity; 0x2 = reverse CT2 polarity; 0x4 = reverse CT3 polarity

name: [CONFIG] Gain adjust 1
interpretation: Gain multiplier = raw unsigned value / 10000.

name: [CONFIG] Gain adjust 2
interpretation: Gain multiplier = raw unsigned value / 10000.

name: [CONFIG] Gain adjust 3
interpretation: Gain multiplier = raw unsigned value / 10000.

name: [CONFIG] Nominal CT volts 1
interpretation: IEEE-754 float32; low 16-bit word first.

name: [CONFIG] Nominal CT volts 2
interpretation: IEEE-754 float32; low 16-bit word first.

name: [CONFIG] Nominal CT volts 3
interpretation: IEEE-754 float32; low 16-bit word first.

name: [CONFIG] Connection type
decode: 0 = custom mapping; 1 = wye; 2 = delta; 3 = branch circuits; 4 = house and inverter; 5 = line-to-line

name: Serial number
interpretation: Unsigned 32-bit value; low 16-bit word first. value = (second register << 16) | first register.

name: Options
decode: 0x2 = even parity factory option; 0x4 = factory baud configured; 0x20 = CT amps factory configured; 0x200 = factory Modbus address configured; 0x400 = CT amps locked; 0x800 = configuration locked; 0x1000 = LEDs disabled; 0x2000 = no DIP-switch logic

name: Factory config lock
decode: 0 = configuration not factory locked; 1 = configuration factory locked

name: Lifetime net energy
interpretation: Signed 32-bit integer; low 16-bit word first. Non-resettable total; multiply by 0.1 for kWh.

name: Lifetime imported energy
interpretation: Signed 32-bit integer; low 16-bit word first. Non-resettable total; multiply by 0.1 for kWh.

name: Lifetime exported energy
interpretation: Signed 32-bit integer; low 16-bit word first. Non-resettable total; multiply by 0.1 for kWh.

name: Active power total
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Watts = raw value multiplied by PowerIntScale (1609).

name: Active power 1
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Watts = raw value multiplied by PowerIntScale (1609).

name: Active power 2
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Watts = raw value multiplied by PowerIntScale (1609).

name: Active power 3
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Watts = raw value multiplied by PowerIntScale (1609).

name: Average phase-to-neutral voltage
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Multiply by 0.1 for volts.

name: Voltage AN
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Multiply by 0.1 for volts.

name: Voltage BN
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Multiply by 0.1 for volts.

name: Voltage CN
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Multiply by 0.1 for volts.

name: Average phase-to-phase voltage
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Multiply by 0.1 for volts.

name: Voltage AB
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Multiply by 0.1 for volts.

name: Voltage BC
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Multiply by 0.1 for volts.

name: Voltage CA
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Multiply by 0.1 for volts.

name: Integer frequency
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Multiply by 0.1 for hertz.

name: Current 1
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Amperes = raw value multiplied by CT rated current 1 (1604), divided by CurrentIntScale (1622).

name: Current 2
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Amperes = raw value multiplied by CT rated current 2 (1605), divided by CurrentIntScale (1622).

name: Current 3
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Amperes = raw value multiplied by CT rated current 3 (1606), divided by CurrentIntScale (1622).

name: Firmware version
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer.

name: Power failure count
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer.

name: Lifetime operating time
interpretation: Unsigned 32-bit integer; low 16-bit word first. Total operating seconds since factory calibration; low word first.

name: [CONFIG] CT rated current 1
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Readback only; configure the meter to match the installed current transformer.

name: [CONFIG] CT rated current 2
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Readback only; configure the meter to match the installed current transformer.

name: [CONFIG] CT rated current 3
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Readback only; configure the meter to match the installed current transformer.

name: Power integer scale
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Readback of actual power multiplier, including automatic mode.

name: [CONFIG] Current integer scale
interpretation: Signed 16-bit integer. Divide raw current times rated current by this value; no fixed amps-per-count assumption.
